purpose: Define a combined human/machine profile projection over IdentityCore, PortfolioCore and MeritCore while preserving which values are descriptive, evidenced, verified or derived.

value.separation_rule: Every projected field/value retains its semantic owner/source class.
value.evidence_rule: Authored/descriptive values and verified evidence are distinguishable.
value.derived_rule: MeritCore-derived values are marked as derived from MeritCore rather than copied as profile facts.
value.cv_rule: A living CV-like profile may be generated from these layers without becoming the canonical source record.
value.privacy_rule: Projection obeys each component's visibility/privacy policy.
value.localization_rule: Human-facing labels may be localized while underlying identities/values remain unchanged.
value.mutation_rule: Editing the projection routes changes to the owning component operation.
